content.title: Waste Diversion Action Plan
content.summary: The City of Arvada is implementing a Waste Diversion Action Plan in collaboration with Resource Recycling Systems to enhance sustainability efforts and improve waste diversion across the community. The plan, which runs from May 2024 to October 2025, includes stakeholder engagement, data collection, and alignment with Arvada's Climate Action Plan, ultimately aiming to provide policy recommendations and strategies for better waste management. Community involvement will be prioritized through workshops and surveys to ensure the plan meets local needs.
content.body:
![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4594)

The City of Arvada is advancing its sustainability efforts through a new Waste Diversion Action Plan. The City is partnering with Resource Recycling Systems (RRS) to help with the plan development. RRS has contracted with the [Front Range Waste Diversion (FRWD) Board within Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment](https://cdphe.colorado.gov/press-release/cdphes-front-range-waste-diversion-program-announces-grant-funding-to-promote) to provide no cost technical consulting to Front Range communities such as Arvada.

The Waste Diversion Action Plan aims to build on Arvada's recent achievements — such as the adoption of a [single-hauler ordinance with universal curbside recycling in 2021](/731) — by further improving waste diversion across the community.

## Key Objectives

The Waste Diversion Action Plan will focus on:

- **Increasing waste diversion** across residential, commercial, and municipal operations.
- **Engaging stakeholders** through targeted workshops and data collection to align the plan with community needs.
- **Coordinating efforts** with [Arvada’s Climate Action Plan](/1028), ensuring the strategies complement each other.

## Project Milestones

The project is scheduled to run from May 6, 2024, to October 28, 2025. Key milestones include:

- Baseline assessment of Arvada's solid waste system
- External data collection to inform the waste diversion plan
- Gap and opportunities assessment
- Workshop with City staff
- Final Waste Diversion Action Plan presentation to City Council

## Community Engagement

Throughout the project, RRS and Arvada will:

- Host a series of sector-specific meetings with residents, businesses, and city staff.
- Collect insights from stakeholders and local organizations to shape plan recommendations.
- Incorporate feedback through focus group workshops with Arvada staff to refine the strategies.

## Plan Timeline

- **Nov. 2024:**Focus groups targeting the commercial / business community and multi-family residents and property managers
- **Jan. - Feb. 2025:**Community-wide online survey
- **Feb. - Jul. 2025:**Plan development
- **Jul. - Aug. 2025:** Staff final review
- **Oct. 28, 2025:**Final plan presentation to City Council

## Expected Outcomes

The Waste Diversion Action Plan will serve as a strategic roadmap for programs, policies, and investments that further enhance waste diversion in Arvada. The final plan will include:

- Policy recommendations for improved waste management
- Infrastructure needs and future investment strategies
- Engagement actions to foster participation
- Implementation timelines for key initiatives
